# Dr. James Kumar Pallivathukkal

> Specialist in Internal Medicine and Diabetes at Badr Al Samaa Royal Hospital,
> Al Ghubrah Street, Muscat 133, Oman. Saturday–Thursday 8:30 am–9 pm, Friday
> closed. Appointments by phone (+968 9751 0975) or WhatsApp.

Dr. James provides comprehensive internal medicine for adults in Muscat:
diabetes and metabolic health, heart and blood pressure risk, kidneys, lungs,
liver and gut, thyroid, sleep and energy, joints and care for older adults —
looked after together by one senior physician.
